summary: Reads a cursor/input position (two fields) via DualFieldRead into locals v8/v9. Computes bounding-region boundaries with sub_487060 (mode 0 and 1) and sub_4870E0 (mode 0 and 1). If the input position lies strictly inside the region (v8 between both v2/v3 and v9 between both v4/v10), toggles the state flag at this[0xE0] (0->1, 1->0, 2 unchanged, other values reset to 1); when outside the region the flag is set to 1. Then dispatches the state via the vtable+0x40 method and runs the vtable+0x98 method, returning 0.

operations.description: Initialize the two input locals v8 and v9 to zero before DualFieldRead writes them.
Call sub_487060(this, 0) and sub_487060(this, 1) to obtain the two horizontal bounding boundaries v2 and v3.
Call sub_4870E0(this, 0) and sub_4870E0(this, 1) to obtain the two vertical bounding boundaries v4 and v10.
Call DualFieldRead(&v8, &v9) to read the two cursor/input position fields into the locals.
Enter the toggle branch only when v8 is strictly between v2 and v3 and v9 is strictly between v4 and v10 (input inside the bounding region).
Toggle the state flag this[56] (0xE0) on a hit: 0 -> 1, 1 -> 0, 2 stays 2, any other value resets to 1. When the input is outside the region the flag is set to 1.
Read the vtable pointer from this and dispatch the updated state this[56] through the vtable+0x40 method (this, this[56]).
Read the vtable pointer from this and invoke the vtable+0x98 method on this as a post-dispatch step.
